title: Deshaun Watson: Preseason games great opportunity to showcase what I can do

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deshaun Watson: Preseason games great opportunity to showcase what I can do
sources.description: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson said on Saturday that his performance in training camp thus far has "been decent" and that he has his eyes on the next steps in his push to win the starting job in Cleveland.
